'''Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator''' was a custom-made [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]] that was built by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] for the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]]. It resembled a similar craft, the [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']], that was built by RSS for [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and was possibly of the same design. However, unlike that craft, it had no [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking]] technology. Ezzar used it in the [[Destruction of the Almas Academy]], when he attacked the [[Almas Academy]].<ref name="Destruction">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: Destruction}}</ref> He then flew it to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] afterwards.<ref name="AHSNV">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance}}</ref>
